title: Immunoblotting Protocol
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Incubate the blot with primary antibodies ( 01:00:00 ; 1:1,000 dilution in TBS-T, 1% BSA), Overnight at 4°C.
Incubate the blot with HRP-conjugated secondary antibodies ( 00:45:00 ; 1:1,000 dilution in TBS-T, 1% milk), at Room temperature .
Analyze protein band intensity using ImageJ software ( http://fiji.sc ; RRID:SCR_002285).
Normalize protein levels to loading controls (e.g. GAPDH).

steps.title: Prepare protein samples
steps.instruction: Mix each protein sample with LDS sample loading buffer and add β‑mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Load samples onto gel
steps.instruction: Load 20–40 µg total‑cell‑lysate protein or 1 µg purified protein per well of a precast NuPAGE 4‑12 % Bis‑Tris gel, alongside molecular‑weight markers.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run the gel for 1 hour at 170 V, room temperature, using MOPS running buffer.

steps.title: Activate PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Immerse the PVDF membrane in methanol for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Assemble transfer sandwich
steps.instruction: Place the gel and activated PVDF membrane in the transfer cassette, ensure no air bubbles, then insert the cassette into a transfer tank containing an ice block and fill with transfer buffer containing 20 % methanol.

steps.title: Transfer proteins
steps.instruction: Transfer for 1 hour at 100 V (or alternatively overnight at 30 V) in a cold room.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate the blot for 1 hour in TBS‑T supplemented with 5 % non‑fat dry milk at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the blot three times, each wash for 5 minutes in TBS‑T at room temperature.

steps.title: Detect with ECL
steps.instruction: Apply enhanced chemiluminescence (ECL) substrate to the blot and capture protein signals using the Bio‑Rad ChemiDoc MP imaging system.
